plans.idea: Keep the original's left-copy / right-product structure: logo and badge share a top row, a tall left text column gives the headline 3 big lines with the subhead tucked under it, and the sneaker sits centred in the right column.

Top-to-bottom stack for the near-square: logo left and badge right in a header row, a full-width headline band reading as 2 bold lines plus a one-line subhead, then a wide centred sneaker filling the lower half.

Mirrored split with the product first: logo above and the NEW VIDEO badge below the sneaker form a left image column, so the badge stays with what it labels, and the right column holds the headline and subhead stacked and top-aligned with the logo.
